profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, BioML at NVIDIA | CS/AI PhD from UCLA
profile.summary:
PhD from @UCLA
Now working on BioNeMo and NIMs

Additional expertise:
Computer Vision
Generative Modeling
Transformers
Adversarial Defense/Learning
Scene Understanding and 3D Graphics modeling.

Software: C, C++, CUDA, Python, Java, MATLAB, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, TensorFlow, Keras, Caffe, PyTorch, 
Solutions: Semantic and instance segmentation, scene understanding, human skeletal detection, pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, CNN, RNN, LSTM, Adversarial Defense MCMC GAN VAE FLOW EBM and Diffusion models.

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Software Engineer - Biological LLMs for Drug Discovery
positions.description:
- Developed ML infrastructure for NVIDIA BioNeMo foundation models, including ESM2 and Geneformer, supporting large-scale biological modeling workloads.
- Improved distributed training efficiency, model performance, accuracy, and usability across multi-GPU systems.
- Built benchmarking and metrics infrastructure to track throughput, latency, and deployment performance for NVIDIA NIM inference services.
- Optimized AI workloads using mixed- and low-precision techniques, including BF16, FP8, and FP4.
- Collaborated across BioNeMo, NeMo, NIM, and NVIDIA Cosmos teams to accelerate and productionize large-scale foundation models.

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles Perception
positions.description: - Prototyped sensor fusion (camera, radar, lidar) neural networks for obstacle detection

positions.title: Machine Learning Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles Perception
positions.description:
- Led Neural Network KPI infrastructure; delivered metrics dashboard widely adopted by perception team.
- Developed visualization app for evaluating various perception models (lane line detection, obstacle detection, freespace prediction, parking spot identification.
- Built KPIs and contributed research on 3D freespace detection.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Used Energy-based models to defend against adversarial attacks on image based neural networks. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.13525 (published in ICLR 2021)
- Added Energy-based models to Generative Adversarial Networks so we can probabilistically model the output distribution of any generator network. (published in Neurips 2022) https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2022/file/062f9525a7476942f61a6c3b42d0a63f-Paper-Conference.pdf

company.name: UCLA Henry Samueli School of Engineering and Applied Science

positions.title: Computer Vision Engineer
positions.description:
- Focus on Computer Vision and Deep Learning, specifically Human pose detection and Instance Segmentation.
- Added MobileNetV2 to Tensorflow and Keras (first OSS contribution)

positions.title: Technical Mentor
positions.description: - I was teaching myself ML while tutoring for Udacity

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Designed a device/procedure that allows people to insert contact lenses without touching them.
Resources: Solidworks, CAD, 3D printing

positions.title: Self Taught Computer Programming
positions.description: I graduated with a Bachelors in EE and focused on Radio and Microwave Antennae, so I had almost no background in computer programming. During this period I was tutoring high school students in Math and teaching myself Javascript, Linux and Web Development almost entirely through books and online communities. In September I went to a coding bootcamp to become proficient in Web Development, but quickly pivoted afterwards to teach myself ML through Udacity's Self Driving Car Nanodegree

positions.description: Systems Engineering Intern in the Automation group.

positions.title: Ablation Intern
positions.description:
•Developed a program to process, archive, and analyze neurostimulation data from a prefrontal cortex scan.
•Simulated EMG signals in MATLAB using Virtual Studio along with a Picoscope and a Biopac EMG detector. 
•Wrote an algorithm to induce hypothermia using a focused ultrasound beam.
•Synchronized the Ultrasonic Beam with the Data Acquisition Device.

•Concert Venue guide.

projects.title: Vehicle Speed Estimation from Dashboard Cam
projects.description: Trained a convolutional neural network using dense optical flow analysis techniques to estimate the speed of a vehicle given a video from it's dashboard cam and ground truth data.

projects.title: GamesReviewAPI
projects.description:
•	Parsed game review data from ign.com and filled MySql database tables using an MVC pattern
•	Designed ES7 generator functions to synchronously seed the database with 18k row entries
•	Implemented hash tables on the front end to allow constant-time form validation on query parameters

publications.title: Bounding Box Embedding for Single Shot Person Instance Segmentation
